name: ai_hk_frame_update_0222bc10
notes: SprjHkAiManager per-frame update: steps the AI world by 1/30 s (the 60 FPS patches: 1/60), AI debug display and drawing

name: render_frame_update_02377bd0
notes: per-frame: ages a list of ref-counted objects, updates RendMan-side child, steps another child by 1/30 s (Uncap: measured frame time)

name: frame_timing_frame_step
notes: Per frame: SprjWindow running check; creates SprjFlipper; calls the limiter; runs the task update; returns running and not quitting

name: frame_timing_flipper_init
notes: SprjFlipper constructor: reads Game.FlipMode (default 4; pending default 3; clamped to 4); unset in the shipped config

name: frame_timing_pace_frame
notes: Frame limiter: target interval at +0x18 (1/30 or 1/60 s); spins out the frame (the sleeping wait is compiled in but unused); 32-frame ring; every FPS patch edits it

name: frame_timing_task_frame_024512a0
notes: task manager frame entry from the frame step: FD4TaskManager singleton, then 0x01388c60

name: render_read_present_pool_counter
notes: full-QWORD locked read/writeback retry, XOR before each attempt; caller adds one. Real AMD64 write cycles retained; non-AMD64 bridge unresolved Synthetic edges pass; no recordings.

name: kernel_condition_wait
notes: Dantelion2 PthreadCondition wait (untimed when timeout is -1); the FPS patches put a ret on the timed path

name: render_clear_swap_chain_curve
notes: Release the swap-chain curve resource through its owner; clear only the resource after the callback.

name: render_clear_swap_chain_cached_record
notes: Release the swap-chain cached-record resource through its owner; clear only the resource after the callback.

name: render_swap_chain_present
notes: GXSwapChainCtrl present: waits for the present interval in 60 Hz vblanks, maps it to a flip mode, presents (Uncap: mode 0)

name: engine_wide_string_destroy
notes: WideString destructor; unsigned capacity >=8 frees even null; ignores owns; callback before capacity and size reset and two-byte terminator

name: loading_file_handle_open
notes: Translate game mode bits to FreeBSD open flags and permissions; store descriptor and set the open bit on success; -1 on failure

name: loading_file_handle_read
notes: Read up to size bytes from the descriptor into the buffer and publish the count; descriptor low 32 bits zero-extended; no open-bit check; -1 on a negative kernel result

name: loading_file_handle_write
notes: Write up to size bytes from the buffer to the descriptor and publish the count; descriptor low 32 bits zero-extended; no open-bit check; -1 on a negative kernel result

name: loading_file_handle_seek
notes: Move the descriptor to an offset relative to origin and publish the new position; origin low 32 bits zero-extended; no open-bit check; -1 on a negative kernel result

name: input_mouse_construct
notes: Constructs a mouse input object: base part, vtable, cleared state, libSceMouse load and init, then the object's virtual method at +0x100; clears the handle slot on failure.

name: input_initialize_mouse_for_initial_user
notes: Initializes or reinitializes mouse input for the initial user, closing a previous connection if necessary.

name: input_pad_set_vibration
notes: Sets a pad output's large and small motor speeds through scePadSetVibration; false when vibration is disabled or the call fails.

name: render_allocate_shader_upload
notes: Allocate one shader-upload slice of at most 64 KiB. If no suitable block exists, acquire once, reclaim, then retry once. Preserve zero-size requests and delegate block policy to the original manager.

name: render_command_submit_present
notes: Prepare and delegate a present submission, preserving capacity-failure returns and resetting begin markers to the live cursor.

name: render_command_submit_batch
notes: Emit counter waits and submit nonempty regions with the packed video/index handle, or delegate the snapshot when no optional context exists.

name: render_command_submit_snapshot
notes: Initialize the auxiliary command buffer and submit nonempty regions using only the video handle.

name: render_present_record_consume
notes: Track resource range or emit record commands; preserve cached tokens, index wrap and final state resets. Static reconstruction Synthetic GCC/Clang edges pass; no recordings.

name: render_present_last_record_consume
notes: Consume the final record range, or update its tracking bank when commands are not admitted.

name: render_flush_shader_preparation
notes: Flush the pending barrier/range before the event. Mode 0 keeps the range fields, and a suppressed state returns without touching either group of fields.

name: render_record_derive_parameter
notes: Derive numeric normalization code; flag priority and mode-dependent base.

name: render_record_auxiliary_predicate
notes: Return the auxiliary-processing predicate: selectors 0x13/0x14 enable it, 0x15/0x16 use flag bit 6, and all other selectors disable it.

name: render_reset_present_preparation_dirty
notes: Emit changed depth and stencil clear values, then cache their post-call values. Preserve the second writer's upper return bits while replacing its low word.

name: render_swap_chain_present_mode
notes: Validates low DWORD mode; retains object, loads full source pointer at +0x33d0, forwards mode to lower submit Synthetic GCC/Clang edges pass; no recordings.

name: render_setup_swap_chain
notes: Allocate and register swap-chain buffers, initialize cached resource data and tone curves, and retain partial publications on the corresponding failure paths.

name: render_swap_chain_submit
notes: Owned-thread flip polling, source binding and submission; every exit reloads the global guard pointer. Native GPU helper effects remain original Synthetic GCC/Clang edges pass; no recordings.

name: loading_close_file_streams
notes: Close the three stdio streams of a StreamSet last field first and null each; called from two destructors
